Disclaimer* DP Aircraft I Limited 28 September 2026 28 September 2026 DP Aircraft I Limited Interim Report and Accounts The Board of DP Aircraft I Limited ("DPA" or the "Company") announces that it has today, in accordance with DTR 6.3.5, released its Unaudited Condensed Consolidated Interim Report for the six-month period ended 30 June 2026. The Report is available on the Group's website: https://www.dpaircraft.com/investors/financial-statements . Copies of the Unaudited Condensed Consolidated Interim Report for the six-month period ended 30 June 2026 have been submitted to the National Storage Mechanism and will shortly be available for inspection at: https://data.fca.org.uk/#/nsm/nationalstoragemechanism .
